@graph.name: Ríos Huayhuash
@graph.description:
Se presenta una red hidrográfica inteligente, bajo un sistema de red ordenado por el sistema de codificación Pfafstetter, es topológicamente consistente y de aplicación global.
  
  El código del curso de agua te permitirá ubicar en red hidrográfica nacional; además, con la interpretación de sus códigos podrás identificar a qué unidad hidrográfica pertenece.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/hh_rios_ana/download -p /data/hh_rios_ana/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/hh_rios_ana
  cd /data/hh_rios_ana
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  ogr2ogr -nln hh_rios_ana download/hh_rios_ana.json 'https://geosnirh.ana.gob.pe/server/rest/services/P%C3%BAblico/Rios/MapServer/37/query?where=1%3D1&geometry=%22xmin%22%3A-77.33%2C%22ymin%22%3A-10.7%2C%22xmax%22%3A-76.55%2C%22ymax%22%3A-9.8&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&outFields=*&returnGeometry=true&outSR=4326&f=geojson 2>&1'
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/hh_rios_ana.json -nlt multilinestring -nln hh_rios_ana
  echo success: hh_rios_ana.json loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE hh_rios_ana
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE hh_rios_ana DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'hh_rios_ana',
    'geom_local', 5387, 'multilinestring', 2
  );
  UPDATE hh_rios_ana
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),5387)));
  CREATE INDEX hh_rios_ana_geom_local_idx
    ON hh_rios_ana
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
